long_biography.plain_text:
The Vernicos family began moving people and petroleum barrels across the Bosphorus in the mid-nineteenth century, later adding steam towage and salvage before relocating to Piraeus. Dimitris Vernicos entered that inherited maritime platform as the fifth generation. With his brother George, he became an operator of Ancora Investment Trust, a family shipping company active in product and chemical tankers.

A generational handover accompanied the family's 2019 decision to combine its towing company with Italy's Scafi. Vernicos became president of the resulting group, expanding its role in port towage, salvage and pollution response across the eastern Mediterranean. He and his brother established Nautilus Management in 2023; its first acquisition was a handysize bulk carrier renamed V Bros.
